title: Spacelift Policy Contract
description: Complete schema defining all Spacelift policy types, their input data structures, and expected rule outputs

ACCESS.description: Access policies control whether users can access specific stacks.

session.description: Session information for the user requesting access

input.description: Access policy input with mutually exclusive authentication and resource types

deny.description: Deny all access to the stack or module, whatever the other rules decide

deny_write.description: Suppress write access: when true, a write rule that would otherwise grant write access is ignored, leaving read access if the read rule grants it and denial otherwise

read.description: Grant read access to the stack or module

write.description: Grant write access to the stack or module. Write implies read

APPROVAL.description: Approval policies determine whether runs require manual approval before they can proceed.

current.description: Reviews cast against the current state of the run

older.description: Reviews cast before the run last changed

reviews.description: Approvals and rejections recorded for this run

run.description: The run awaiting approval with additional approval-specific fields

approve.description: Approve the run and allow it to proceed

approve_with_note.description: Reasons to approve the run. A non-empty list approves it, and each entry is recorded against the approval

reject.description: Reject the run and prevent it from proceeding

reject_with_note.description: Reasons to reject the run. A non-empty list rejects it, and each entry is recorded against the rejection

GIT_PUSH.description: Push policies are triggered by Git push events and determine how Spacelift should respond to repository changes.

in_progress.description: Runs currently in progress for this stack. The builders always emit an array, empty when there are none; the empty-string form is accepted because a stored input carried it

push.description: Push event information (may be null in some cases)

stack.description: Stack that may be affected by this push

current_version.description: Number of the module's latest version. Reads 0.0.0 when the module has no version yet

module.description: Module that may be affected by this push

input.description: Push policy input with either stack or module

allow_fork.description: Allow a run for a pull request opened from a forked repository

cancel.description: Identifiers of in-progress runs to cancel

external_dependency.description: External dependency markers the resulting run must wait on

fail.description: Report the push as failed against the commit

ignore_track.description: Suppress tracking: when true, a track rule that would otherwise track the commit is ignored, leaving a proposed run if the propose rule is set and ignoring the push otherwise

lock.description: Lock the stack under this identifier. Every policy evaluated for the push must agree on the value

message.description: Text to send as the commit status message in place of the default. Entries from every policy evaluated for the push are joined with a comma

module_version.description: Version to publish when the push targets a module

notify.description: Send a commit status check for a push Spacelift would otherwise ignore without one. Applies only to ignored pushes, so setting it false does not suppress checks for any other outcome

notrigger.description: Track the commit without triggering a run for it

prioritize.description: Put the resulting run ahead of others on a private worker pool queue

priority.description: Priority level of the resulting run on a private worker pool queue: high, normal or low. Cannot be combined with prioritize

propose.description: Trigger a proposed run without tracking the commit

track.description: Track the pushed commit and trigger a tracked run

unlock.description: Unlock the stack held under this identifier

INTENT.description: Intent policies control resource operations evaluated through the Intent API.

resource_id.description: Identifier of the resource being operated on

operation.description: Operation being performed (create, update, delete, refresh, import)

current_state.description: Current resource state. Keys are defined by the resource's provider, not by Spacelift

proposed_state.description: Proposed resource state. Keys are defined by the resource's provider, not by Spacelift

allow.description: Reviews approving the operation, empty when there are none

deny.description: Reviews rejecting the operation, empty when there are none

input.description: Intent policy input: the resource operation plus any prior reviewer decisions

deny.description: Reasons to deny the operation (vetoes allow)

LOGIN.description: Login policies control user authentication and authorization.

member.description: Whether the account's identity provider counts the user as a member. With GitHub, true for members of the account's GitHub organization and false for any other GitHub user. With SAML or OIDC, always true. With Google, GitLab or Microsoft, true only for the admin email, which skips login policies, so false for every user a login policy sees

session.description: Session information for the authenticating user

input.description: Login policy input with mutually exclusive user and Slack authentication

admin.description: Grant admin privileges to the user. True in any login policy on the account grants them, unless deny_admin is true in any

allow.description: Allow the login (non-admin access). True in any login policy on the account lets the user in. session.login is set on every session, so a condition that only checks that it is set lets in anyone the identity provider authenticates

deny.description: Deny the login attempt. True in any login policy on the account denies the login, whatever the other policies allow

deny_admin.description: Deny admin privileges while leaving non-admin access intact. It cancels only the admin rule: a space-admin role on the root space still makes the user an account admin

deny_message.description: Messages shown to the user if the login is denied. A message never denies the login on its own; the allow, admin and deny rules decide that

anyOf.description: Role slugs granted in this space, keyed by slug. Only entries set to true are granted
Role slugs granted in this space

roles.description: Role slugs to grant, keyed by space slug. Grants from every login policy on the account add up, so a grant without a condition applies to every user that any login policy lets in. Read role slugs from roles[].slug in the input or from the slug field of Role with query. A space-admin role on the root space makes the user an account admin, whatever deny_admin says

sample.description: Advanced: whether to store this evaluation's input and result in the policy's evaluation records. Unlike every other policy type, login policies sample by default, so set this to false to opt out.

team.description: List of teams to assign to the user. They replace the teams from the identity provider, so the user gets every role bound to them. Teams from every login policy on the account add up, so a team without a condition applies to every user that any login policy lets in

NOTIFICATION.description: Notification policies control when and how notifications are sent for various Spacelift events.

account.description: The account the notification belongs to

internal_error.description: Set when Spacelift itself failed, rather than a run or module version changing

note.description: Optional note for the state transition

plan_policy_decision.description: Plan policy outcome for the run

policy_receipts.description: Policy execution receipts. Null when the run has none

timing.description: Time spent in each state the run has left. The state the run is in now has no entry, and the value is null until the run leaves its first state

username.description: User who triggered the state change

run_updated.description: Set when a run changed state

module.description: The module that has a new version

module_version.description: Set when a module version changed state

message.description: Human-readable summary of the usage against the contract

contracted_percentile.description: Percentile the contract bills concurrency at

concurrency_at_contracted_percentile.description: Concurrent workers at the contracted percentile over this billing cycle, up to the last midnight UTC

limit_ratio.description: concurrency_at_contracted_percentile over contracted_limit. Zero when the contract carries no worker cap, since there is nothing to be over

previous_limit_ratio.description: limit_ratio a day earlier. Both figures are taken at a midnight, exactly a day apart, so comparing them fires once when a threshold is first crossed

burst_budget_minutes.description: Minutes above the contracted limit the contract allows for the cycle

burst_used_minutes.description: Minutes spent above the contracted limit this cycle, up to the last midnight UTC

burst_remaining_minutes.description: burst_budget_minutes less burst_used_minutes, floored at zero

burst_ratio.description: burst_used_minutes over burst_budget_minutes. Zero when the contract allows no burst, since there is no budget to spend

previous_burst_ratio.description: burst_ratio a day earlier. Compare with burst_ratio to fire once when a threshold is first crossed

cycle_start.description: Start of the billing cycle, as Unix seconds

cycle_end.description: End of the billing cycle, as Unix seconds. Exclusive upper bound

worker_usage.description: Set when an account's private-worker usage is running into its contract

input.description: Notification policy input with different event types

inbox.description: Notifications to place in the Spacelift inbox

severity.description: Severity level for the message: INFO, WARNING or ERROR

title.description: A custom title for the message

pull_request.description: Comments to post on pull requests

deduplication_key.description: Key used to update an existing comment instead of adding another

truncate_body.description: Whether to truncate a comment body that exceeds the provider's limit

slack.description: Messages to send to Slack channels

channel_id.description: The Slack channel the message is delivered to, taken from the bottom of the channel's About section

mention_groups.description: Groups to mention in the default message

mention_users.description: Users to mention in the default message

message.description: A custom message to send instead of the default

thread_key.description: Groups related messages into one Slack thread. The first message with a given key starts the thread and later ones reply to it

webhook.description: Payloads to deliver to webhook endpoints

endpoint_id.description: Slug of the endpoint the webhook is delivered to

headers.description: Headers to append to the request

method.description: HTTP method to send the request with

payload.description: A custom JSON object to send as the request body

PLAN.description: Plan policies evaluate Terraform plans before they are applied.

ansible.description: Ansible plan data, passed through as the vendor produced it

changes.description: Changes from the CloudFormation change set

kubernetes.description: Kubernetes plan data, passed through as the vendor produced it

opentofu.description: OpenTofu plan data (for OpenTofu stacks; also mirrored under terraform for backwards compatibility)

checks.description: Check block results from the plan

opentofu_version.description: OpenTofu version that produced the plan

resource_changes.description: Resource changes, as the vendor's plan JSON reports them

spacelift.description: Spacelift context with either stack or module

terraform.description: Terraform plan data (for Terraform stacks; for OpenTofu stacks it mirrors opentofu for backwards compatibility)

checks.description: Check block results from the plan

resource_changes.description: Resource changes, as the vendor's plan JSON reports them

terraform_version.description: Terraform version that produced the plan

checks.description: Check block results from the plan

resource_changes.description: Resource changes, as the vendor's plan JSON reports them

terraform_version.description: Terraform version that produced the plan

custom.description: Custom plan policy inputs, keyed by the file that supplied them: a file named wiz.custom.spacelift.json lands under the key wiz. Contents are defined by that file, not by Spacelift

infracost.description: Infracost report, absent unless the run produced one. For Terragrunt it is keyed by project, for Terraform and OpenTofu it is the report itself. No other vendor emits it. Report contents are defined by Infracost, not by Spacelift

deny.description: List of reasons to block the plan from being applied

warn.description: List of warnings about the plan

TASK.description: Task policies control the execution of administrative tasks within stacks.

remote_ip.description: IP address of the request origin

session.description: Session information for the user executing the task

stack.description: Stack where the task is running

module.description: Module where the task is running

input.description: Task policy input with either stack or module

deny.description: List of reasons to block the task from executing

TRIGGER.description: Trigger policies are executed when tracked runs reach terminal states or when module versions are created.

run.description: The completed run that triggered this policy

stack.description: Stack associated with the completed run

stacks.description: List of candidate stacks for triggering

queued_runs.description: Number of queued runs for this stack

oneOf.description: Trigger policy input triggered by a completed run

module.description: The module that had a new version

stacks.description: List of candidate stacks for triggering

queued_runs.description: Number of queued runs for this stack

oneOf.description: Trigger policy input triggered by a module version

input.description: Trigger policy input with either run-triggered or version-triggered variants

priority.description: Priority level of every run this policy triggers on a private worker pool queue: high, normal or low. Policies that disagree about one stack leave its run at normal

trigger.description: List of stack IDs to trigger as a result of this run's completion

exist_on_tracked_branch.description: Whether the commit exists on the tracked branch

pull_request_id.description: Pull request ID if the commit is from a PR

request.description: The request document as it stood when the review was recorded. Stored at the time, so its keys follow whichever version wrote it

session.description: The session document as it stood when the review was recorded. Stored at the time, so its keys follow whichever version wrote it

branch.description: Git branch tracked by this module

contexts.description: Context slugs attached to the module

policy_flag.description: Advanced: arbitrary strings to attach to this evaluation. Where the policy evaluates against a run, they appear on that run's policy receipt and are readable as run.flags by policies evaluated later for the same run.

policy_reset_flag.description: Advanced: flags to clear. A flag is only cleared once every policy that set it has also requested the reset, so one policy cannot clear another's flag.

policy_sample.description: Advanced: set to true to store this evaluation's input and result in the policy's evaluation records, where the policy workbench can replay it.

affected_files.description: List of files affected by the push

affected_stacks_count.description: Stacks and modules on this repository, across all spaces of the account, whose project root or additional project globs match the affected files, including this one when it matches. Counted before any policy runs. It is the fan-out of the push, and the number of runs created can be lower.

commits.description: Individual commits batched into this push (e.g. by a merge queue), oldest first.

affected_files.description: List of files affected by this individual commit

remote_ip.description: IP address of the request origin

stack.description: The stack the triggering run ran on

trigger.description: The run that triggered the triggering run

admin.description: Whether the session has admin privileges. Absent from a login policy input, where an IdP admin does not reach the policy. An empty string on a run whose creator was a machine

creator_ip.description: IP address where the session was created

idp_subject.description: Subject (sub) claim from the identity provider that authenticated the session. Empty only for a secret-based API key

machine.description: Whether the session belongs to a machine rather than a person. Always false in a login policy input

stack_id.description: Slug of the stack whose run holds this session. Present only for a session Spacelift issued to a run, which a login policy never receives

channel.description: Slack channel the command came from

team.description: Slack workspace the user belongs to

user.description: Slack user who ran the command

deleted.description: Whether the Slack account is deleted

display_name.description: Display name from the user's Slack profile

enterprise.description: Slack Enterprise Grid membership, zero valued outside an Enterprise workspace

id.description: Identifier of the user within the Enterprise Grid organisation

is_admin.description: Whether the user administers the Enterprise Grid organisation

is_owner.description: Whether the user owns the Enterprise Grid organisation

teams.description: Workspaces within the organisation that the user belongs to

has_2fa.description: Whether the user has two factor authentication enabled

is_admin.description: Whether the user administers the workspace

is_owner.description: Whether the user owns the workspace

is_primary_owner.description: Whether the user is the workspace's primary owner

is_restricted.description: Whether the user is a multi-channel guest

is_stranger.description: Whether the user belongs to no shared workspace

is_ultra_restricted.description: Whether the user is a single-channel guest

real_name.description: The user's real name as Slack holds it

branch.description: Git branch tracked by this stack

contexts.description: Context slugs attached to the stack

locked_by.description: User who locked the stack, if any

roles.description: Spacelift roles granted on this stack

terraform_version.description: Terraform version used by the stack (Terraform stacks only, null for other vendors)

terraform_workflow_tool.description: Terraform workflow tool (Terraform stacks only, null for other vendors)

latest.description: Whether this is the latest version

items.description: One test run for the version

updated_at.description: Last update Unix timestamp in nanoseconds

id.description: Worker pool identifier. Absent for the public pool rather than null

labels.description: Worker pool labels. Absent for the public pool rather than null

name.description: Worker pool name. Absent for the public pool rather than null

public.description: Whether this is the public worker pool

ulid.description: Role ULID (Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier)

is_default.description: Whether this is the default integration

affected_stacks_count.description: Stacks and modules on this repository, across all spaces of the account, whose project root or additional project globs match the pull request's changed files, including this one when it matches. Counted before any policy runs. It is the fan-out of the event, and the number of runs created can be lower.

draft.description: Whether this is a draft PR

comment.description: Pull request comment, present only when the event carries one

after_run.description: Commands to run after the entire run

environment.description: Environment variables for the run. Names are chosen by the account, not by Spacelift

runner_image.description: Docker image used for the run

terraform_version.description: Terraform version used by the run (Terraform stacks only, null for other vendors)

phase.description: Phase of the change (plan or apply)

action.description: Type of change. A replaced resource has one change, destroy-Before-create-replaced or create-Before-destroy-replaced.

entity.description: The entity the change applies to

author_roles.description: Roles the author had at the time of the event

identity.description: Resolved identity of the reviewer, present when one resolves

note.description: Note the reviewer left with the review, empty when they left none

request.description: The request document as it stood when the review was recorded. Stored at the time, so its keys follow whichever version wrote it

session.description: The session document as it stood when the review was recorded. Stored at the time, so its keys follow whichever version wrote it

state_version.description: State version of the approval event

based_on_local_workspace.description: Whether the run is based on local workspace

identity.description: Resolved identity of the person who created the run, present when one resolves

drift_detection.description: Whether this is a drift detection run

flags.description: Flags set on this run by the flag rule of policies evaluated earlier for it

force_apply_mode.description: Whether the apply phase is forced despite a zero-change plan

repository_runtime_config_changed.description: Whether the repository runtime config has changed (approval-specific)

trigger.description: The run that triggered this one, if any

triggered_by.description: Who or what triggered the run

identity.description: Resolved identity of the person who created the run, present when one resolves

priority.description: Tier the run was queued in, one of high, normal or low

promoted.description: Whether the run was promoted from a proposed run

state.description: Current run state - must be terminal

trigger.description: The run that triggered this one, if any

entity.description: One resource, output, stack, module or Ansible task in a plan or apply

data.description: Vendor specific detail. Which keys are present depends on entity_vendor and entity_type

module.description: Terraform module the resource belongs to

outputs.description: Pulumi resource outputs. Keys are defined by the resource, not by Spacelift

outputs_hash.description: Hash of the Pulumi resource outputs

tainted.description: Whether Terraform marked the resource tainted

value.description: Output value, empty when the output holds no value

values.description: Terraform resource attributes. Keys are defined by the resource's provider, not by Spacelift

values_hash.description: Hash of the Terraform resource attributes

entity_type.description: What kind of entity this is: resource, output, stack or module

entity_vendor.description: Which vendor produced the entity: terraform, opentofu, pulumi or cloudformation. Legacy OpenTofu stacks (Terraform vendor with the OPEN_TOFU workflow tool) report terraform

host_name.description: Ansible host the task ran against

playbook_name.description: Ansible playbook the task belongs to

role_name.description: Ansible role the task belongs to, empty when it has none

type.description: Type of the entity as the vendor reports it

identity.description: A resolved Spacelift identity for the person who acted

id.description: The person's external identifier for this provider

username.description: The person's external username for this provider, when the provider reports one

federations.description: External accounts linked to this identity, keyed by provider

change.description: The change Terraform plans for this resource

actions.description: One or more of no-op, create, read, update, delete

after.description: Attributes after the change, null when the action is delete. Keys are defined by the resource's provider, not by Spacelift

after_unknown.description: Attributes whose values are not known until apply. Keys are provider-defined

before.description: Attributes before the change, null when the action is create. Keys are defined by the resource's provider, not by Spacelift

module_address.description: Address of the module containing the resource

plan_check.description: One check block result, as the vendor's plan JSON reports it. The vendor controls its keys

state_transition.description: One state a run passed through

new_state.description: The state the run moved into

note.description: Note recorded with the transition, present only when one was given

username.description: Person who caused the transition, present only when a person did
